description:
Get daily Google Search Console metrics (clicks, impressions, CTR, position) for one or more search query keywords within a property. Pass a single keyword (keyword) or up to 50 at once (keywords array — mutually exclusive with keyword); the bulk form returns a results array with one daily series per keyword, keyed by the input. Accepts a date range as presets (last_7_days, last_28_days, last_3_months, last_year) or as absolute dates (from/to in Y-m-d format). Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties. Each keyword carries search_volume: Google Ads average monthly searches in the country filter if one is given, else in the search-volume market of the property; value is null unless state is ok or zero (not_fetched = not looked up yet), as_of is the month it was fetched. Each keyword also carries seasonality from the same Google Ads fetch: demand_curve lists the trailing 12 months oldest first as {month: Y-m, searches}, peak_month is the busiest month and seasonality_index is that month over the monthly average (1.0 = flat demand); an empty list and nulls when unknown. Each keyword also carries volume_by_country: its Search Console clicks, impressions and position per country in the period next to that country's search_volume, with demand_share (impressions per month over average monthly searches, 0..1, null without searches), traffic_value_eur (the clicks at that country's Google Ads low bid, else at the search-volume market's, in EUR; null without any volume) and hint: demand_not_visible for a country with searches but no impressions (listed after the others, position null), visible_little_demand for impressions where Google shows no searches, else null. Only volumes already fetched are shown; an empty list when nothing is known.

Cost: 3 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// Daily GSC metrics for a single keyword over the last 28 days.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","keyword":"best running shoes","range":"last_28_days"}
```

keywords.description: Up to 50 search queries to fetch at once. Mutually exclusive with keyword.

range.description: Date-range preset. Mutually exclusive with from/to; pass either range or both from and to.
